title: CI: run lint and build, call one test entry point, use pytest, cache browsers and Poetry
description:
.github/workflows/tests.yml runs npm run typecheck but never npm run lint or npm run build (the first next build after merge happens in Amplify Hosting). It also runs a hand-picked list of 24 test targets while package.json test:ci:ts chains 59, so 31 targets never run on PR. The python job runs python -m unittest over a module list, which collects zero tests from the five pytest-style modules (test_priming_curation, test_priming_http, test_priming_provider_budget, test_priming_biblicus_contract, test_biblicus_worker_configuration), and installs without --with cyclotron so all @requires-cyclotron behave features skip. Playwright is installed uncached on every run for one script, and there is no Poetry cache.

Fix: add npm run lint and npm run build to the ts job (the amplify_outputs.json stub at line 23 already exists); replace the step list with a single npm run test:ci:ts (or the node:test runner once PPY issue 'Convert scripts/test-* to node:test' lands); switch the python job to poetry run pytest with src added to testpaths and python_files including *_test.py, keeping the current exclusions as -k deselects with their PPY tickets; add --with cyclotron to poetry install; cache ~/.cache/ms-playwright and ~/.cache/pypoetry; add permissions: contents: read and npm ci to inbound-email-tests.yml; drop the duplicate test:theme-packs step.

Done when: the workflow is green on develop and the step list in CI is one entry point, not a hand-maintained copy of package.json.

Source: full code review of develop @ e9b1923 on 2026-10-17 (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/f01a3c9f-7fad-4df2-8a15-ac6c27cc83ed). Branch from origin/develop, name the branch after this issue, open a PR into develop, and record branch, PR link and verification in a comment here before closing.
